## Bridge DELIBERATELY paused — this alarm is expected until further notice

`reconcile-bridge.yml` was disabled by operator decision (`gh workflow disable`, now
`disabled_manually`) at the time of this comment. **This canary will keep reporting stale until
it is re-enabled. That is expected and is not a new fault.**

### Why

The bridge was failing every hourly run AND re-posting roughly 205 duplicate comments per pass
across ~28 Jira issues (~4,920/day). Root cause is confirmed and filed as
`irongrey-chubby-oxpecker` (`aa7b-5e47-6d3d-4615`, P1): the PRIMARY comment-dedup skip
`binding_store.is_comment_mapped(local_comment_key)` is inert in production because the
`comment_ids` map is empty —

```
git show origin/tickets:.bridge_state/bindings.json
  bindings:     2475 entries
  comment_ids:     0 entries
```

— leaving only the lossy body-equality fallback, which never matches richly-formatted comments.
REB-1861 matched 1 of 40 and filled Jira's 5000-comment cap, which is what reds this canary.

The bridge was net-negative: its sync already failed every run, while the duplicates it posted
are durable and require manual cleanup. Pausing stopped accumulating damage at the cost of sync
that was not working anyway.

### What must happen before re-enabling

1. `irongrey-chubby-oxpecker` lands (root cause under `/rebar-debug` now — the open question is
   which of the four silent guards in `_record_comment_id` leaves the map empty).
2. The already-posted duplicates are remediated, following the `bd80-0603-7d44-4d9f` precedent.
3. Re-enable with `gh workflow enable reconcile-bridge.yml` — an operator decision, not an
   automatic consequence of the fix landing.

This ticket auto-closes when the next successful reconcile-bridge run is detected, so it will
close on its own once the bridge is fixed and re-enabled. No action needed on it directly.

Follow-up `marshy-chummy-coot` (`2399-5e49-6b28-4d59`) tracks root-causing how the defect
escaped review, tests and CI.
